text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of a U-Turn prohibitions on Canongate Trail, between Purcell Square and Elmfield Crescent (North Leg) and on Elmfield Crescent, between Canongate Trail north and south intersections. These prohibition will reduce conflicts and improve safety along these local roads, which is located in close proximity to Kennedy Public School.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited northbound and southbound U-Turns at all times on Canongate Trail, between Purcell Square and Elmfield Crescent (north intersection). 2. Prohibited eastbound, westbound, northbound, and southbound U-Turns at all times on Elmfield Crescent, between Canongate Trail (north intersection) and Canongate Trail (south intersection).
